title_card.title: A 2,000-year-old computer was found.
title_card.subtitle: It was recovered from an ancient shipwreck.

caption:
Divers recovered a 2,000-year-old geared computer from an ancient Greek shipwreck.

Discovered in 1901 near the island of Antikythera, the mechanical device calculated astronomical positions and eclipses with remarkable precision. Scholars determined it contained dozens of fine bronze gears.
